first.rationale: The concurrent declines in onboarding completion and activation make onboarding simplification the most directly relevant durable lever. Prior evidence indicates it improved completion, time-to-value, and early adoption; activation messaging is a close complementary alternative, so both relevant archived records should be checked before commitment. Promotional pricing addresses the competitive threat but carries established retention risk, conflicting with sustainable qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. It directly targets the 4% onboarding-completion decline and has verified evidence of improving completion (+13%), time-to-value (-2.1 days), and 30-day retention (+3%), supporting sustainable qualified revenue. It is also likely to relieve the activation decline through faster initial value realization. Activation messaging remains a validated follow-up candidate, but onboarding simplification has the stronger evidence for downstream retention and addresses the earlier funnel failure.
